segments.text: Ok so this is the Frontend Tools page for Google ADK with Vue, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
So this is the problem, it says the agent can call the tool, but there's no agent side step at all.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked to show only sev one incidents, it should change the filter, but the agent just answers in text and it stays on all.
So a plain ADK agent needs the AGUI toolset to get the tool, umm, and the page never says that. With it added, it works.
That's the problem here, please have a look.
